# The DLLs each file of the Windows set may import by name: a set member, a system DLL or a VC++
# run-time DLL that policy/host-prerequisites.txt lists. Each file's rows must equal the DLL names
# of its import descriptors, its delay imports, which the delay helper loads by name, and the DLLs
# outside the set its forwarders name, which the loader loads with .dll added, ignoring case, so an
# added or a dropped import fails verification until a reviewed edit here. One row per file and DLL:
# <file> <dll>. python3 -I tools/lib/windows_policy.py rows <set-dir> <driver> policy
# allowed-imports prints the rows for a set, from the files verification takes out of the locked
# MSI.
